description: Land Title Settlement Department - Watinapaha, Minuwangoda D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510400 (23/0582)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, and property details including parcel numbers, extents, ownership information, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
